_comment: §12 S1 real-failure fixture — banked as T3 regression corpus (AC-65.3)
description: getTransaction returned null for all 30 polling attempts (~60s) after a Jito-routed buy. The tx was eventually confirmed via getSignatureStatuses fallback which returned confirmationStatus=finalized with err=null. A synthetic SendResult is returned so the Position row can be created and tokens are not orphaned. Without this fallback, Jito txs that land after the getTransaction window create orphan positions.
notes: Jito-routed txs can land on-chain before the Solana RPC indexes them in getTransaction. The getSignatureStatuses endpoint is faster to reflect. Never abandon a Position because getTransaction times out — always fall back to signatures check.
